abilities.name: Void Command
abilities.text: Once per round, after you clear a sector or complete a Contract, record a private command briefing.

abilities.name: Ashwake Step
abilities.text: At the start of your turn in a clear sector, record a private command briefing.

abilities.name: Signal Relay
abilities.text: Once per round, after you win a battle with another operative in your sector, record how the command relay held the line.

abilities.name: Marshal's Presence
abilities.text: Once per round, after a successful objective push, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0.
